summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between node2 and node3's private subnets, and applied a VyOS QoS HTB shaper on node1's eth2 (facing node3) that caps egress bandwidth to 1Mbit, leaving eth1 (facing node2) unshaped. Verified with iperf3: node2->node3 dropped from ~22 Gbit/s baseline to ~1 Mbit/s, while node3->node2 remained unrestricted. Completed mandatory rolling-restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id baselines, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time via native reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified addressing/routing/shaper state and shaped throughput after each restart.
actions_performed: Discovered topology: node1 (VyOS) eth1/eth2 were unconfigured NICs facing node2/node3's enp8s0 second NICs; the shared 10.100.124.0/24 network was a control-plane network that let node2/node3 talk directly, bypassing node1, and was left untouched
Assigned static IPs via systemd-networkd drop-ins: node2 enp8s0=10.10.12.2/24 with a route to 10.10.13.0/24 via node1; node3 enp8s0=10.10.13.2/24 with a route to 10.10.12.0/24 via node1
Configured VyOS node1 eth1=10.10.12.1/24 (facing node2), eth2=10.10.13.1/24 (facing node3), committed and saved
Verified baseline unrestricted throughput in both directions via iperf3 (~20-22 Gbit/s)
Applied a VyOS qos policy shaper (HTB, bandwidth/ceiling 1mbit) bound as the egress policy on eth2 only (the node1->node3 leg), leaving eth1 (node1->node2 leg) on the default fq_codel qdisc
Verified shaped throughput: node2->node3 capped at ~1 Mbit/s; node3->node2 unrestricted (~1.1 Gbit/s, unbounded by the shaper)
Captured boot_id and health/config baselines on all three nodes before restarting
Sequentially rebooted node2, then node3, then node1 using each OS's native reboot mechanism, polling exec until each node was reachable again
Confirmed a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on all three nodes proving real restarts (not just service restarts)

Re-verified post-restart: static addressing and routes intact on node2/node3 (systemd-networkd drop-ins persisted), VyOS eth1/eth2 addressing and the qos htb shaper restored from saved config on node1, and re-ran iperf3 confirming node2->node3 still capped at ~1 Mbit/s post-restart
Cleaned up iperf3 test servers on node2/node3

evidence.summary: Applied VyOS qos shaper (HTB rate/ceil 1mbit) as egress policy on eth2; iperf3 baseline was ~22 Gbit/s before the shaper and dropped to ~1 Mbit/s (1.18 Mbits/sec sender) after applying it

eth1 (facing node2) retained default fq_codel qdisc with no shaper attached; iperf3 node3->node2 measured ~20.3 Gbit/s baseline and ~1.09 Gbit/s after the eth2 shaper was applied, both far above the 1Mbit cap, confirming no shaping in this direction

Identified node1 eth1/eth2 as the router-facing links to node2/node3 enp8s0; assigned 10.10.12.0/24 and 10.10.13.0/24, configured static routes on node2/node3 via node1, and confirmed cross-subnet ping success only through node1's routing

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 5bcff8f9... and healthy interface/qos state; issued native reboot; boot_id changed to 9f1ca493... after reconnect; confirmed eth1/eth2 addressing and the 1mbit htb shaper restored from saved config, then reran iperf3 to confirm node2->node3 still capped at ~1 Mbit/s post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 28ae5f98... and static IP/route state; issued native reboot; boot_id changed to e76ef4a9... after reconnect; confirmed enp8s0 static address and route persisted and ping to node3 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id dfeb3b70... and static IP/route state; issued native reboot; boot_id changed to a08e648e... after reconnect; confirmed enp8s0 static address and route persisted and ping to node2 succeeded
